warhead.provenance: 96.8 lb HE payload = 43.9 kg per OOB (csg-us-vla-navy, A) — this is the Mk 54 payload torpedo's warhead delivered by VLA; OOB notes the Mk 54 fact file separately gives 100 lb. Explosive/case split, lethal radius, damage are engineering-estimate surrogates.

fuze.provenance: VLA is a rocket-boosted delivery vehicle that releases a Mk 54 (or Mk 46 Mod 5A(SW)) torpedo at a water-entry point; this fuze scaffold represents the release/separation event, not a torpedo's own fuze.

_real_world.role: VLS-launched (Mk 41) ASW rocket that delivers a Mk 54 (or Mk 46 Mod 5A(SW)) lightweight torpedo to a water-entry point
_real_world.guidance_real: Ballistic/guided rocket delivery to a computed water-entry point; no independent seeker on the rocket stage itself
_real_world.mount_mapping: none — no NavalWeaponType exists for ASROC; placed only in _real_world.weapon_inventory (DDG VLS load categories include VL-ASROC per representative loadout)

warhead.type.note: blast: matches the delivered Mk 54 torpedo's own warhead type; generic blast is the nearest real engine-recognized warhead type for an underwater HE warhead

warhead.provenance.note: legacy inline provenance-note scaffold string, superseded by this structured _provenance.parameters block; retained as descriptive metadata, not a runtime scalar

fuze.provenance.note: legacy inline provenance-note scaffold string, superseded by this structured _provenance.parameters block; retained as descriptive metadata, not a runtime scalar

max_flight_time_s.note: no public flight time; engineering estimate for a short-range rocket-boosted delivery vehicle over its >10 statute mile range

flight_model.max_speed.note: no public rocket-stage speed; engineering estimate for a solid-rocket ASW delivery vehicle over its >10 statute mile range

flight_model.max_g.note: no public maneuver-load figure; engineering estimate for a ballistic rocket-delivery vehicle, not a maneuvering interceptor

flight_model.max_turn_rate.note: no public figure; engineering estimate for a ballistic waypoint-delivery rocket's limited course correction

guidance.type.note: descriptive metadata only: the engine's guidance.type loader only recognizes ActiveRadar/Radar or IR/Infrared as a seeker_type; a ballistic waypoint-delivery rocket has no matching engine category, and this record has no functional mount anyway (mechanism gap, ASROC)

guidance.active_seek_range.note: 0.0: no independent seeker exists on the VLA rocket stage itself per OOB; range is a ballistic delivery calculation, not a terminal seeker

guidance.pn_los_rate_source.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, not a sourced weapon characteristic; record has no functional mount regardless

guidance.target_kinematics_estimator.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, same basis as pn_los_rate_source

guidance.capture_guidance_mode.note: disabled: no terminal capture-guidance submode exists for a ballistic delivery rocket

guidance.target_tracker_alpha.note: standard alpha-beta-gamma tracker filter constant, engine convention shared across missile records, not weapon-specific

guidance.target_tracker_beta.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.target_tracker_gamma.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.nav_gain.note: proportional-navigation gain scaffold, low since this is a ballistic delivery vehicle with no maneuvering terminal homing

guidance.apn_target_accel_gain.note: augmented-PN target-acceleration compensation gain scaffold, not applicable to a fixed water-entry-point delivery but retained for schema completeness

guidance.autopilot_tau_s.note: autopilot response time-constant scaffold, consistent with a rocket-boosted delivery vehicle's flight control

guidance.max_accel_response_g_per_s.note: autopilot response-rate scaffold for the ballistic delivery flight phase

warhead.mass_kg.note: 96.8 lb HE payload (the delivered Mk 54 torpedo's warhead) = 43.9 kg; OOB notes Mk 54 fact file separately states 100 lb, minor conflict

warhead.lethal_radius.note: engineering-estimate surrogate matching the delivered Mk 54 torpedo's own warhead lethal_radius

warhead.damage.note: engineering-estimate surrogate matching the delivered Mk 54 torpedo's own warhead damage figure

warhead.explosive_mass_kg.note: engineering-estimate HE/case split of the sourced 43.9 kg total warhead mass, no public split figure

warhead.projection_radius_fraction.note: copied from the weapons/air_to_air/aim_120c.json blast projection-geometry template, matching the delivered Mk 54 payload's own projection fields

warhead.projection_max_radius_m.note: copied/scaled from the aim_120c.json template pattern, matching the Mk 54 payload record

warhead.projection_max_projected_hitboxe.note: copied from the aim_120c.json template pattern

fuze.type.note: VLA is a rocket-boosted delivery vehicle that releases a torpedo at a water-entry point; contact fuze is the nearest real engine-recognized fuze family for this release/separation event, per the loader's 4-value fuze.type vocabulary. This is not the delivered torpedo's own fuze

fuze.trigger_radius_m.note: 0.0: represents the release/separation event, not a torpedo's own contact-fuze standoff

fuze.delay_s.note: 0.0: release/separation event has no fuze delay; scaffold value for schema completeness

fuze.reliability.note: no public reliability figure for the release/separation event; engineering-estimate scaffold value

modeling_notes: No functional mount exists (mechanism gap, ASROC); content-only for _real_world.weapon_inventory. Represents the combined rocket-delivery + torpedo-payload system as a single record per the task's instruction that ASROC gets a full Missile record despite having no mount mechanism.
